{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden knows that Islamophobia has no place in society.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"President Biden knows that Islamophobia has no place in our society."},
{"claim_text":"Agencies across President Biden's Administration are taking action to fight Islamophobia and support Muslim Americans.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"Across his Administration, agencies are taking action to fight Islamophobia and support Muslim Americans."},
{"claim_text":"The Biden Administration is developing the first-ever U.S. National Strategy to Counter Islamophobia and Related Forms of Bias and Discrimination, including hate against Arab, Sikh and South Asian Americans.","claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence":"His Administration is developing the first-ever U.S. National Strategy to Counter Islamophobia and Related Forms of Bias and Discrimination, including hate against Arab, Sikh and South Asian Americans."},
{"claim_text":"President Biden is the first president in history to recognize the International Day to Combat Islamophobia.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"He is the first president in history to recognize the International Day to Combat Islamophobia, and his Administration released a Dear Colleague Letter reminding schools, including institutions of higher learning, of their legal obligation under Title VI to address discrimination, including harassment, based on race, color or national origin, including discrimination against students who are or are perceived to be Muslim, Arab, Sikh, South Asian, Hindu or Palestinian based on shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics."},
{"claim_text":"The Biden Administration released a Dear Colleague Letter reminding schools, including institutions of higher learning, of their legal obligation under Title VI to address discrimination, including harassment, based on race, color or national origin.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"He is the first president in history to recognize the International Day to Combat Islamophobia, and his Administration released a Dear Colleague Letter reminding schools, including institutions of higher learning, of their legal obligation under Title VI to address discrimination, including harassment, based on race, color or national origin, including discrimination against students who are or are perceived to be Muslim, Arab, Sikh, South Asian, Hindu or Palestinian based on shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics."},
{"claim_text":"The Biden Administration reminds schools that Title VI requires addressing discrimination against students who are or are perceived to be Muslim, Arab, Sikh, South Asian, Hindu or Palestinian based on shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics.","claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence":"He is the first president in history to recognize the International Day to Combat Islamophobia, and his Administration released a Dear Colleague Letter reminding schools, including institutions of higher learning, of their legal obligation under Title VI to address discrimination, including harassment, based on race, color or national origin, including discrimination against students who are or are perceived to be Muslim, Arab, Sikh, South Asian, Hindu or Palestinian based on shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics."}],
